details:
ANIMA : Advanced Network for Integrated Medical Assistance

ANIMA is an intelligent astronaut health-monitoring and decision-support platform designed to improve crew safety, well-being, and medical autonomy during long-duration space missions, particularly when communication with Earth is delayed.

How It Works?

ANIMA brings multiple physiological and behavioral health indicators into one interactive dashboard, including heart rate, heart-rate variability, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, temperature, sleep, fatigue, exercise activity, and bone-health measurements.

The system compares measurements with each astronaut's personalized baseline to identify unusual physiological trends. Through transparent, rule-based analysis, ANIMA generates explainable early-warning alerts, helping astronauts understand what has changed and why it matters.

The platform also includes an interactive anatomical visualization, a daily health check-in, an experimental personalized physiological state model, and an AI assistant designed to answer health-related questions through natural language.

Our broader mission-planning prototype explores personalized 24-hour schedules and communication with Mission Control, allowing medical teams to review health information and proposed adjustments while accounting for deep-space communication delays.

Technologies Used

ANIMA is developed using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Recharts for its interactive interface and health-data visualizations.

The application is deployed using Vercel, while Microsoft Azure is part of our cloud architecture for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and AI model services. Python supports data preparation, analysis, and future predictive-model evaluation.

The current prototype uses structured synthetic datasets to demonstrate physiological monitoring and health scenarios. Integration with physical biomedical sensors is a future development objective.

Innovation and Impact

ANIMA's innovation lies in connecting personalized monitoring, explainable AI, conversational assistance, and mission-level decision support within one platform.

Rather than simply displaying medical measurements, ANIMA aims to help astronauts recognize concerning changes, understand their health trends, and communicate effectively with medical teams.

Our intended impact is to support earlier identification of potential health concerns, improve crew autonomy, and contribute to safer human exploration of the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

Key Considerations

Our team prioritized scientific transparency, data reliability, personalization, astronaut privacy, communication limitations, and human oversight.

We clearly distinguish simulated measurements from real data, avoid unsupported medical predictions, and design ANIMA as a decision-support tool rather than an autonomous diagnostic system.

Our vision is simple: wherever humanity explores, intelligent and accessible healthcare support should follow.
